title: Roadmap accepted-risk follow-ups: copies lost or altered at the target between checks, and copies not encrypted
outcome: Roadmap accepted-risk follow-ups: copies lost or altered at the target between checks, and copies not encrypted
acceptance: The 'do not protect against' list in docs/roadmap.md's accepted-risk paragraph names the target losing or altering its copies. Status reports recorded evidence and sees this only at the next push or `backup status --check-target`, and only the newest copy is ever re-checked.
The same list names disclosure at the target: copies are not encrypted, and a store copy is readable by anyone who can read the target, so the target must be readable only by the operator's account.

completion.summary: Documented accepted backup risks: target loss or alteration between newest-copy checks, ordinary status's recorded evidence, older copies not rechecked, and unencrypted disclosure limited by operator-only target access.
